description: This file defines the SlidingTabStrip class, a custom UI component for rendering a tab indicator strip in an Android application. It manages visual aspects such as indicator lines, dividers, and borders, and handles drawing logic for the tab indicator.

classes.name: SlidingTabStrip
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout that renders the indicator, borders, and dividers for a tab layout in an Android UI.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer

classes.name: SimpleTabColorizer
classes.description: Inner class implementing TabColorizer, used to provide default colors for indicators and dividers.
